hooks.command: cd {{PROJECT_PATH}} && CHANGED=0; diff -q .memory/ia-config/CLAUDE.md CLAUDE.md >/dev/null 2>&1 || CHANGED=1; diff -q .memory/ia-config/settings.local.json .claude/settings.local.json >/dev/null 2>&1 || CHANGED=1; for f in .memory/ia-config/commands/*.md; do b=$(basename "$f"); diff -q "$f" ".claude/commands/$b" >/dev/null 2>&1 || CHANGED=1; done; [ $CHANGED -eq 1 ] && echo 'ia-config desincronizado — rode /sync-config para aplicar mudancas do Obsidian' || exit 0
